```yaml
name: Integration Tests - Beyla

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'internal/test/integration/**'
      - 'go.mod'
      - 'go.sum'
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - release-*
    paths:
      - 'internal/test/integration/**'
      - 'go.mod'
      - 'go.sum'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  integration-tests:
    name: Integration Tests
    runs-on: self-hosted
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - test-suite: "beyla"
            weights-file: "internal/test/integration/weights-beyla.yaml"
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: 'go.mod'

      - name: Generate integration test matrix
        run: |
          ./scripts/generate-integration-matrix.sh ${{ matrix.weights-file }}

      - name: Run integration tests
        run: |
          make integration-test
        env:
          WEIGHTS_FILE: ${{ matrix.weights-file }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          TEST_TIMEOUT: 600
```
